propositions: Zizmor security audit is scoped only to release.yml; gerrit-verify.yaml and _build-and-test.yml (the vote-casting path) are not audited despite being in the dev extra.
Third-party action refs in gerrit-verify.yaml and _build-and-test.yml use mutable tags (@v7) despite a line-21 claim asserting all actions are SHA-pinned.
Distribution metadata validation (twine check) runs only at release time, not pre-merge, missing an opportunity to catch packaging defects before merge with minimal cost.
Rebar enforces a 70% branch coverage floor while urllib3 and cryptography enforce ~100%; the OSS-aligned improvement is diff-coverage on changed lines, not a global floor raise.
CodeQL static analysis is currently scheduled-only; gating it on Gerrit Verified would add substantial pre-merge latency and is deferred to an explicit owner decision.
